figurative_meaning_en: To cause complete ruin or destitution
example_sentences_in_bangla: ব্যবসায়ের লোকসান তাকে পথে বসিয়ে দিয়েছে।
এই ভুল সিদ্ধান্ত তার জীবনকে বসিয়ে দিয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The business loss has left him ruined on the streets.
This wrong decision has completely ruined his life.
note: Often used in contexts of economic downfall in Bengali literature and speech
